title: Catching the online thieves
body: In a town, several families lost money when they clicked on fake payment links sent to their phones. Such crimes, done using digital means, are called cybercrime. Some years earlier, the country's assembly of elected representatives had passed a new law that made such online cheating a punishable crime. After the families complained, the cyber police traced the criminals and arrested them. The accused were then brought before a court, which heard both sides, found them guilty of breaking the law, and ordered them to pay a fine and spend some years in jail.
